title: Whistling UFO seen near Aztec

tellings.quote: The UFO came from that [music] direction over there, but it was making this sound like almost whistling.

plain: A UFO came in from one direction near Aztec, New Mexico, making a sound that was almost like whistling. That is how an unnamed local witness, who says they saw it themselves, describes it on an episode about a reported crash of a craft with alien bodies in that area, where it would add to the story that something unusual has been seen there.
